The holes share one axis. The orange side has a standard 3.4 mm M3 clearance hole; the green side carries the proposed heat-set cavity.
Accepted V3 fit geometry, ears, source upper heads, eyes, lower-face/rear-cassette ownership, reinforcement direction, C006, and aluminum V0.5 remain unchanged.
Service-path behavior must be measured and reported, not assumed.
Green source-shell integration, physical heat-set strength, tool access, vibration life, and any manually enlarged hole remain unresolved until later approval and coupons.
No STL, G-code, slicer project, fabrication output, or print release is produced.
